title: Kenyan Lamb Kebabs
description: A fusion of Kenyan and Chinese flavors, these lamb kebabs are a unique twist on traditional Chinese street food.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, curry powder, ginger, and garlic.
2. Add the sliced lamb to the marinade and mix until coated.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
5. Thread the marinated lamb onto kebab skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
7. Meanwhile, toast the nimble spring onions in a pan with a small amount of oil until fragrant.
8. Serve the lamb kebabs with toasted spring onions on top.
9. Garnish with additional spring onions and serve immediately.
